headline: Graph and attention models fuse spatial and single-cell multi-omics data
label: Spatial Multi Omics Deep Learning
summary: Recent spatial and single-cell integration tools pair graph learning with histology-to-omics inference and uncertainty-aware fusion.
synthesis: The dominant thread is graph- and attention-based learning that integrates single-cell and spatially resolved measurements across modalities. SpaMosaic performs mosaic integration of spatial multi-omics with contrastive learning and graph neural networks, while INSPIRE integrates multiple spatial transcriptomics datasets via adversarial graph neural networks and NMF. scFNSA factorizes attention over single-cell multi-omics by decoupling modality-specific variational representations. A second line uses H&E histology as input: H2O infers spatial transcriptomics and proteomics from histopathology images, and EP-Booster predicts spatial gene expression from refined foundation-model embeddings. Mievformer learns microenvironment embeddings from spatial omics via masked self-supervised learning. CMGL estimates per-patient modality confidence via evidential deep learning before fusion. The recurring novelty is pairing learned multi-view representations with uncertainty estimates or biological interpretability. Bulk-oriented items such as CellPulse and GeneLift fall outside this thread.
